title: 17th Fairway Spanish Retreat
description:
This newly constructed custom home is a spacious six bedroom, 5 1/2 bathroom house with a large modern kitchen, a pool, a sport court, and an outdoor kitchen to entertain the whole family. 

Four of the bedrooms are located in the main portion of the house while the additional two bedrooms are located in the guest suite wing of the home, which includes its own kitchenette, living room, and laundry room.

TPT: 21661671
Chandler License: 307385

 Other things to note 
The home has a 6’ deep 36 x 15’ pool and 9 x 15’ spa. The pool or spa can be heated upon request. The cost for either is $90/day from October through April and $50/day from May through Sept.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet and dresser
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine

raw_rules: Additional requests: Text your Co-Host once you have departed the residence.
house_rules.additional_rules:
The HOA does not permit cars parked on the street anytime of the day or night. Cars are not allowed within the driveway after 10 pm and must be parked in the garage. There is a four car garage.

Please do not leave doors open, including sliding door, to keep insects and scorpions from entering house.
